heading: From wilderness to legacy
intro: The path to founding Bakers Walking Company was not a straight line. It was carved through experience, partnerships and trial and error. Below are the moments that shaped what exists today.

items.label: The Inspiration
items.detail: Walking the iconic Overland Track and realizing that Tasmania’s true magic is found in its silence and scale.

items.label: Perspective in the Wild
items.detail: Trekking the Kokoda Trail, a lesson in endurance, deep hospitality, and the profound impact of walking through history.

items.label: The Private Sanctuary
items.detail: Acquiring the 1,137-acre estate at Bakers Beach to create a space where wilderness could be experienced without the public crowds.

items.label: Testing the Vision
items.detail: Launching our off-grid basecamp and hosting the first guided tours to refine the balance of rugged adventure and refined comfort.

items.label: Bakers Walking Co.
items.detail: Opening our doors as a dedicated retreat for private groups, focusing on custom itineraries, local hosting, and total immersion.
